senses.gloss: chip, piece of wood; log to be chopped.
units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 32b:6">B. Kam. 32ᵇ</cite> <he>נתזה ב׳ וכ׳</he> a chip slipped out (of the carpenter’s hand) and struck his face; Y. ib. III, end, 3ᵈ. Y. Macc. II, 31ᶜ bot.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Beitzah 4:4:4">Y. Bets. IV, 62ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>אין מכבין את הב׳</he> you must not extinguish the log; v. <cite ref="K00949"><he>כָּסַס</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Shabbat 29a">Sabb. 29ᵃ</cite> top; a. fr.—Pl. (cmp. pl. of <cite ref="K00865"><he>כְּנֶסֶת</he></cite>) <he>בִּקְעִיּוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Chullin 37b:8">Ḥull. 37ᵇ</cite> <he>אפי׳ אוכלת ב׳</he> even if strong enough to bite wood.
<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 3:17">Koh. R. to III, 17</cite> (a gloss expl. <he>גזירין</he>).
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 27">Gen. R. s. 27</cite>, v. <cite ref="B01123"><he>בְּקִיעָה</he></cite>.
